speaker: charlie
text: So there you have it, whales putting on a show, coral getting a fighting chance, and our juniors showing the big leagues how it is done. Not a bad Thursday for good news if you ask me.

speaker: alice
text: Honestly one of my favourite editions, and that sky show last night was just the cherry on top. If you managed to get a photo, we would love to see it.

speaker: charlie
text: Big thanks to Sam for keeping us dry and sunny this weekend, and to all of you for tuning in and being part of the Bright Side family. Get out there and enjoy that spring sunshine.

speaker: alice
text: That is it from us today. Look after each other, look after the coastline, and we will catch you tomorrow with more of the good stuff.
